# UsageMeasurement

`schemas/records/usage-measurement.json`

One usage report for one call (docs/design/m0/05 "Usage and settlement" [M7]). Outputs are fenced; accounting is not: reports are accepted from any attempt, stale or not. internal/capacity/ledger reconciles them: deltas deduplicated by (call, sequence), a final replaces their sum only when not lower, and only a provider_reconciliation can lower a figure.

## Fields of the document

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | [MeasurementID](common-defs.md#measurementid) |  |

| `attempt` | yes | [AttemptID](common-defs.md#attemptid) |  |
| `lease` | yes | [LeaseID](common-defs.md#leaseid) |  |
| `kind` | yes | one of `delta`, `final`, `provider_reconciliation` |  |
| `sequence` | yes | integer (minimum `0`, maximum `9007199254740991`) | Per call: deltas are numbered from 0; a final or reconciliation also carries one, so a later report of the same kind supersedes an earlier. |
| `tokens` | yes | [UsageMeasurementTokens](#usagemeasurementtokens) |  |
| `turns` | yes | [Amount](records-resource-group.md#amount) |  |
| `milliseconds` | yes | [Amount](records-resource-group.md#amount) |  |
| `cost` | yes | [UsageMeasurementCost](#usagemeasurementcost) |  |
| `source_of_truth` | yes | one of `provider_usage`, `adapter_report`, `gateway_count`, `gateway_floor`, `none` | gateway_count and gateway_floor are the gateway's own count of one request it sent (P11b), kept apart from the adapter's reports: gateway_count when it read the upstream's usage in the response it forwarded, gateway_floor when it did not (a floor from the request's size alone). An adapter's final settles a call only when it is not below the gateway's counts and none of them is a floor. |

No other fields are allowed.

Conditional rules (1, `if`/`then`/`else` in the schema):

- when `kind` `provider_reconciliation`, then `source_of_truth` `provider_usage`
